title: Owner's go-ahead past the amendment 2 no-progress stop; Note10+ re-measure clears the 24.4 fps outlier
context: After the no-progress stop at spec review 3 (decision 01M4VS9EEWW390ZAJ95EJDGTDP), the owner unlocked the Note10+ and said "Phone's unlocked, go ahead and continue." (saved to docs/specs/meadow-snapshot-pacing.decisions.md line 15). The oneflight trial was measured again against the unchanged build, alternating, with the GPU throttle level at 0 before and after every run: onboarding 32.8 and 32.8 fps (p90 63.1 and 62.6 ms) against 33.7 and 33.7 fps (60.3 and 60.8 ms); sharp 12.5 s against 12.0 s in two traced replays per build. The earlier 24.4 fps replay had its scene built before its replay window began (ready step at 0 ms, year step 635 ms against 153 ms).
options: Continue amendment 2: record the re-measure (f-note10-remeasure) and the outlier in f-note10-trials, add three attempts per run and a throttle verdict to 10.15, and dispatch spec review 4
Stay stopped and leave amendment 2 unresolved
option_reasons: The owner gave the word to continue, and the clean re-measure shows the design holds onboarding within 0.9 fps and 500 ms of sharpening on the floor device, inside 10.15's bounds
outcome: Continue. Both review 3 issues are fixed in the record and spec, every check passes, and spec review 4 is dispatched; under the owner's convergence rule the fifth review is the last before hand-off.
